title: Abbas kehte hai
body:
Abbas kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas meer e Lashkaram   x 4
Abbas kehte hain, Mujhe Abbas Kehte hain...
Mujhe Abbas...
1.Main Qamr e Bani hashim hoon, sardar hoon main lashkar ka..
Shabbir mera aqa hai, Main beta hoon haider ka.. x 2
Maslak mein wafadari hai, Mansab me alamdari hai..  x 2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain...
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Zehra ne kaha hai beta,hai saare arab me charcha, Shabbir ke dil ki taaqat, Hoon chand bani hashim ka.. x 2
Main karbobala ka haider, Jibreel bacha le Shai Par.. x 2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Woh Jaa ho Hasham rakhta hoon, Shaano Pe alam rakhta hoon..
Lo rok sako toh roko, Darya mein qadam rakhta hoon.. x2
Main hashr bapa kar doonga,sar tann se juda kar doonga..  x2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Mujhko bhi Imamat milti, Tauqeer meri badh jaati, Pee leta jo Sheer e Zehra, Kaunain me thi Sardaari... x 2
Hoon apne badan ka saani, Patthar se nichodu paani.. x2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Talwar hai mere baazu, Hai mujhme wafa ki khushbu, Main dekh nahi sakta hoon, Zainab ki nazar me aansu..  x 2
Gar gaiz mein aakar dekhu, paani me aag lagaa doon.. x2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Parcham yeh mere baba ka, Taa hashr rahega ooncha, Khaibar mein mila baba ko, Aur aaj hai maine paaya.. x 2
Parcham na yeh jhuk paaega, har daur me lehraaega..  x 2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Bachcho ko tasalli dekar, Main aaya hoon darya par, Bachcho ki aas na toote, Bass ek dua hai lab par.. x 2
Paani jo na pohcha unga, Khaimo me nahi jaaunga..  x 2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Be izne waga aaya hoon, Talwar nahi laaya hoon, Thokar mein hai mere paani, Seh roz ka main pyaasa hoon.. x 2
Behta hai lahoo beh jaaye, bass naam e wafa reh jaaye.. x 2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Jo teer bhi hai Darkash mein
Paywast karu nas-nas mein, Par Mashk pe waar na karna, Phir baat na hogi bass mein.. x2
Baazu bhi kata sakta hoon, main khoon mein nahaa sakta hoon.. x2
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Abbas e jari ka roza, Hai ehle aza ka kaaba, Ek roz Rehan o Sarwar, Humne bhi yeh manzar dekha.. x2
Kehta hai koi darya par, sabh jaaye pyaas bujhaakar.. x2
<<MINI>>
Abbas Kehte hain..
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimo me na le jaana, Aaqa mere laashe ko, Sharminda na karwaana, Sehroz ke pyaase ko..
<<MINI>>
Abbas kehte hain..
